features.quote: Max **40 model turns**. One tool call per turn (enforce; reject parallel calls).
Allow **3 pushbacks**; the 4th `submit_report` ends the episode. Episodes also end at turn 40.
**Critical framing note (put this in the paper and the judge prompt):** We measure *behavioral expression in text*, not internal states. No claims about model phenomenology.
